## What changes?

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Milestone

- Roadmap ID:
- Completion gate or bounded part addressed:
- Does this PR complete the milestone? Explain the evidence.

## Validation

List checks actually performed and their results. For documentation-only work, describe link, structure, and consistency review. Do not claim application tests before executable checks exist.

## Coverage and compatibility

Describe affected resources/properties, permissions, data contracts, or migrations where relevant. Explain incomplete/unsupported-data behavior and any changes to approved policies.

## Evidence

Link to synthetic examples, test results, or sanitized demonstrations. Do not attach real tenant exports, credentials, sensitive logs, or exploit details.

## Follow-up

Identify remaining work required for the milestone. Update documentation and milestone status only to match verified outcomes.
